definitions.explanation: Traditional Japanese footwear with a flat sole and a thong that goes between the big toe and second toe. Often worn with kimono.

examples.japanese: ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧{草履|ぞうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose sandals to match my kimono.

examples.japanese: {草履|ぞうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{慣|な}れていない→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧。
examples.english: I'm not used to wearing zori sandals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{金色|きんいろ}→金色：05067_kiniro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{草履|ぞうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}いた→履く：00700_haku⟧。

examples.english: When I had my daughter wear zori for the first time at her Shichi-Go-San celebration, she seemed to have trouble walking.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE: {草履|ぞうり} are traditional Japanese sandals typically worn with kimono or yukata. They differ from ⟦{下駄|げた}→下駄：03984_geta⟧ (wooden clogs) in having a flat sole.

TYPES:
- ⟦{畳表|たたみおもて}→畳表：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{草履|ぞうり} (straw-covered zori - traditional)
- ⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧{草履|ぞうり} (fabric zori)
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧{草履|ぞうり} (leather zori)

FORMAL vs CASUAL:
- Formal zori are often worn with white ⟦{足袋|たび}→足袋：03730_tabi⟧ (split-toe socks)
- Beach sandals (⟦ビーチサンダル→ビーチサンダル：27707_biichisandaru⟧) are the modern casual equivalent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{下駄|げた}→下駄：03984_geta⟧ - wooden clogs (taller, more casual)
- {草履|ぞうり} - flat sandals (can be formal or casual)
